common_prompt_en: 2D cel animation, Korean dark science-fantasy, cold blue starlight, clean silhouettes, consistent character sheets

common_negative_en: distorted anatomy, duplicate characters, extra limbs, unwanted text, subtitles, broken aspect ratio, asset identity drift

layers.blocking: Right hand remains on the cracked console; eyeline stays on the jump gate
layers.action: One controlled breath, then one uninterrupted dialogue line
layers.look: Cold blue rim light with dim red console bounce

layers.negative: No lip-sync mismatch, no subtitle, no extra hand
